description:
A new kind of bike, the Legion is an urban weapon designed to ride through it all, one wheel or two. We designed our very own 6061-T6 alloy frame with “wheelie specific geometry”, making it super responsive and easy to pick up and manoeuvre, yet stable at high speeds. With the frame being alloy, it’s low in weight but tough enough to handle anything you can throw at it (or throw it at!).
Includes a full chromoly aftermarket fork for unrivalled durability in the streets. This wheelie machine is simply unbeatable and unlike anything else out there right now.

• Pro level 29” wheelie bike frame
• Super short chain stays and wheelie specific geometry
• Lightweight but very strong frame construction
• Radio pro oval tubing
• Compatible with pegs
• Integrated headset
• Is-2000 disc brake mount, max rotor size 160mm
• Includes radio 31.8mm quick release seat clamp
• Includes legion full chromoly aftermarket fork with butted steertube and 6mm laser cut dropouts
• 27.2mm seat post
• Fits up to a 2.40” (60mm) tire
